components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Evidence-channel action with calibrated press feedback.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0 14px; background: var(--accent, oklch(43.5% 0.083 218)); color: oklch(99% 0.003 245); font: 760 14px/1.2 var(--font-sans, system-ui); transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-strong, oklch(34% 0.084 220)); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, oklch(43.5% 0.083 218)); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: scale(0.96); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet command on a paper surface.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0 14px; background: oklch(98.2% 0.004 245); color: var(--accent-strong, oklch(34% 0.084 220)); font: 760 14px/1.2 var(--font-sans, system-ui); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(20% 0.02 250 / 0.075), 0 1px 2px -1px oklch(20% 0.02 250 / 0.08); transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-button-secondary:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(20% 0.02 250 / 0.12), 0 2px 8px -5px oklch(20% 0.02 250 / 0.16); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, oklch(43.5% 0.083 218)); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.96); }

components.name: Research Input
components.description: High-contrast parameter entry with an explicit focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: oklch(38% 0.02 248); font: 780 13px/1.2 var(--font-sans, system-ui); } .ds-field input { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid oklch(76.5% 0.019 240); border-radius: 6px; padding: 9px 11px; background: oklch(99% 0.003 245); color: oklch(17% 0.02 252); font: 400 14px/1.2 var(--font-sans, system-ui); outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: var(--accent, oklch(43.5% 0.083 218)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(43.5% 0.083 218 / 0.24); }

components.name: Parameter Selection
components.description: Selected method with a square acquisition indicator.
components.css: .ds-parameter { position: relative; min-height: 62px; display: grid; gap: 3px; width: 100%; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px 28px 10px 12px; background: oklch(98.5% 0.003 245); color: oklch(17% 0.02 252); text-align: left; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(20% 0.02 250 / 0.075); } .ds-parameter strong { font: 820 13px/1.2 var(--font-sans, system-ui); } .ds-parameter span { color: oklch(51% 0.018 248); font: 400 12px/1.35 var(--font-sans, system-ui); } .ds-parameter::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 11px; right: 11px; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 1px; background: var(--accent, oklch(43.5% 0.083 218)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft, oklch(92.8% 0.026 218)); } .ds-parameter.selected { background: linear-gradient(180deg, oklch(99% 0.003 245), var(--accent-soft, oklch(92.8% 0.026 218))); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent, oklch(43.5% 0.083 218)); } .ds-parameter:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, oklch(43.5% 0.083 218)); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Dark-rail navigation with a calibrated scientific icon and horizontal active trace.
components.css: .ds-nav { position: relative; min-height: 58px; width: 236px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 40px 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 11px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 9px 10px; background: transparent; color: oklch(94% 0.008 248); text-align: left; } .ds-nav span { display: grid; gap: 2px; } .ds-nav strong { font: 760 13px/1.15 var(--font-sans, system-ui); } .ds-nav small { color: oklch(72% 0.019 246); font: 680 11px/1.2 var(--font-sans, system-ui); } .ds-nav::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: 10px; bottom: 0; left: 10px; height: 1px; background: var(--accent, oklch(43.5% 0.083 218)); transform: scaleX(0.2); transform-origin: left; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 180ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-nav.selected { background: oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.1); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.13); } .ds-nav.selected::after { opacity: 1; transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, oklch(43.5% 0.083 218)); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Scientific Icon
components.description: Structural glyph inside a calibrated frame with an acquisition microtrace.
components.css: .ds-scientific-icon { position: relative; width: 36px; height: 36px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--accent-soft, oklch(92.8% 0.026 218)); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px oklch(43.5% 0.083 218 / 0.13); color: var(--accent-strong, oklch(34% 0.084 220)); } .ds-signal { position: absolute; right: 4px; bottom: 4px; height: 6px; display: inline-flex; align-items: end; gap: 1px; } .ds-signal i { width: 1px; height: 4px; background: currentColor; opacity: .34; transform: scaleY(.38); transform-origin: bottom; transition: transform 170ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1), opacity 170ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1), filter 170ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); }

components.name: Instrument Panel
components.description: Nearly square paper surface with a calibration corner.
components.html:
Dataset

Choose one cancer cohort and one or more RNA gene symbols.
components.css: .ds-panel { position: relative; width: 390px; min-height: 150px; border-radius: 4px; padding: 20px; background: oklch(99% 0.003 245); color: oklch(24% 0.018 252); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(20% 0.02 250 / 0.075), 0 1px 2px -1px oklch(20% 0.02 250 / 0.08), 0 14px 32px -28px oklch(20% 0.02 250 / 0.22); } .ds-panel::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 8px; left: 8px; width: 11px; height: 11px; background: linear-gradient(var(--accent, oklch(43.5% 0.083 218)), var(--accent, oklch(43.5% 0.083 218))) 0 0 / 9px 1px no-repeat, linear-gradient(var(--accent, oklch(43.5% 0.083 218)), var(--accent, oklch(43.5% 0.083 218))) 0 0 / 1px 9px no-repeat; opacity: 0.48; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0; color: oklch(17% 0.02 252); font: 780 19px/1.18 var(--font-sans, system-ui); } .ds-panel p { margin: 8px 0 0; color: oklch(51% 0.018 248); font: 400 14px/1.45 var(--font-sans, system-ui); }

narrative.overview: TCGA-TRACE should feel like a calibrated scientific instrument placed on a quiet laboratory bench. The gridded paper canvas, journal-like headings, legible controls and patient-level metrics communicate rigor before decoration. The interface is dense because the work is dense, but every screen preserves a clear sequence from setup to evidence to provenance. Personality comes from a restrained analytical trace: small calibration corners, one evidence signal color, original scientific icon frames, tabular numerals and brief acquisition motion.
keyCharacteristics: One muted evidence color connects every analytical module.
Structural icons combine familiar glyphs with calibrated frames and acquisition microtraces.
Major surfaces are square, quiet and calibrated.
Motion explains acquisition, location, loading or completion.
Methodological context stays beside the parameter it affects.

rules.name: The One Channel Rule
rules.body: One evidence signal color controls navigation, selection and focus throughout the product. Modules never change the interface accent.

rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: Color may classify state or analytical context. It may not imply biological significance that is absent from the statistics.

rules.name: The Journal Heading Rule
rules.body: Serif type is reserved for page-level titles and the product name. Buttons, labels, tables and parameters always use the sans family.

rules.name: The Stable Number Rule
rules.body: Dynamic metrics and numeric table cells always use tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Calibrated Surface Rule
rules.body: Major panels use a restrained 4px corner and one small calibration corner. Rounded floating cards are forbidden.

rules.name: The Flat Data Rule
rules.body: Tables, metric strips and evidence matrices stay flat. Depth is reserved for interaction and layering.

dos: Do keep evidence, uncertainty and model diagnostics visible.
Do use exactly one evidence signal color for selection and focus.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, 40px to 44px targets and WCAG 2.2 AA contrast.
Do use tabular numerals in metrics and numeric tables.
Do animate only state, location, acquisition, loading or completion.
Do keep mobile pages free of horizontal overflow at 320px and wider.
donts: Don't turn the app into a generic SaaS dashboard.
Don't use marketing-style hero layouts or landing-page composition.
Don't imitate hospital or electronic-health-record visual language.
Don't use neon genomics aesthetics, decorative gradients or glowing biological imagery.
Don't create decorative card grids or cards inside cards.
Don't add gratuitous motion, bounce, elastic easing or animations over 300ms for ordinary UI state changes.
Don't hide statistical assumptions behind simplified scores.
Don't use color as the only signal of significance, availability or failure.
Don't use colored side-stripe borders, gradient text or decorative glassmorphism.
